displayed_text_en: Selected {name}. Connect to the ELD to operate it. Hours were not copied.
displayed_text_ar: تم اختيار {name}. اتصل بجهاز ELD لتشغيلها. لم تُنقل ساعات الخدمة.
displayed_text_es: {name}. Conectarse al ELD para operarlo. Las horas no fueron copiadas.
trigger_context: Driver selects an assigned vehicle; device ID is stored and navigation transitions to /connection
available_driver_actions: Connect to ELD via Bluetooth or select disconnected mode

displayed_text_en: Carrier edit accepted. Re-certify the log.
displayed_text_ar: تم قبول تعديل الناقل. أعد التصديق.
displayed_text_es: Se acepta la edición de Carrier. Re-certificar el registro.
trigger_context: Driver taps Accept on a carrier-proposed edit card
available_driver_actions: Edit card removed; certify tab unlocks signature pad for re-certification

trigger_context: Driver taps Reject on a carrier-proposed edit card
available_driver_actions: Edit card removed; log retains driver original records

trigger_context: Driver provides digital signature and submits certification
available_driver_actions: Daily log status updates to Certified badge; certification locked

trigger_context: Driver saves new manual event or updates existing duty status event
available_driver_actions: Pops back to LogDetailPage; invalidates previous certification

displayed_text_en: If the email is registered, reset instructions will be sent.
displayed_text_ar: إن كان البريد مسجّلاً فستصلك تعليمات إعادة التعيين.
displayed_text_es: If the email is registered, reset instructions will be sent. [Documented localization limitation: No Spanish translation in application; English string displayed]
l10n_key: None (hardcoded binary branch on _arabic in forgot_password_form.dart:74-77; not in ARB)
trigger_context: Driver submits password reset request; server accepts request; feedback displays conditionally based on locale (Arabic vs English default)
available_driver_actions: Informational banner displayed; driver can switch back to login

displayed_text_en: The server accepted disconnected mode. No local duty event was created.
displayed_text_ar: قبل الخادم المتابعة دون اتصال. لم يُنشأ حدث واجب محلي.
displayed_text_es: El servidor aceptó el modo desconectado. No se creó ningún evento de servicio local.
trigger_context: Driver chooses to continue in disconnected mode without hardware ELD connection
available_driver_actions: Dismiss banner; proceed to dashboard in disconnected mode

trigger_context: SuggestedEventsPage loaded when one or more logs require re-certification
available_driver_actions: Tap log card to navigate to CertifyTab and re-certify

displayed_text_en: Carrier proposed edits are reviewed and acted upon here.
displayed_text_ar: تُعرض تعديلات الناقل المقترحة هنا للمراجعة والرد.
displayed_text_es: Las ediciones propuestas por el transportista se revisan aquí.
available_driver_actions: Tap log card to inspect and respond to carrier edits

displayed_text_en: Unidentified driving is reviewed in Unidentified Events.
displayed_text_ar: تتم مراجعة قيادة المركبة غير المعينة في شاشة الأحداث غير المحددة.
displayed_text_es: La conducción no identificada se revisa en Eventos no identificados.
available_driver_actions: Navigate to Unidentified Events screen via banner or drawer

trigger_context: Driver opens SelectVehiclePage with zero assigned vehicles in company fleet
available_driver_actions: Tap OK to dismiss; contact motor carrier safety manager or fleet portal

displayed_text_en: I hereby certify that my data entries and my record of duty status for this 24-hour period are true and correct.
displayed_text_ar: أقر بموجب هذا بأن مدخلاتي وسجل حالة خدمتي لهذه الفترة الممتدة لـ 24 ساعة صحيحة ودقيقة.
displayed_text_es: Por la presente certifico que mis entradas de datos y mi registro de estado de servicio para este período de 24 horas son verdaderos y correctos.
trigger_context: Displayed above signature pad when log is in READY status
available_driver_actions: Sign name in signature pad and tap Certify button

trigger_context: SuggestedEventsPage opened when no pending carrier suggestions exist
available_driver_actions: Return to Logs list or home screen

trigger_context: Driver completes pre-trip/post-trip DVIR checklist and signs report
available_driver_actions: Report enqueued for offline sync; navigates back to DVIR list

displayed_text_en: Your record was updated. Review the changes.
displayed_text_es: Su registro fue actualizado. Revise los cambios.
trigger_context: Driver claims unassigned driving event with mandatory remark
available_driver_actions: Events assigned to driver log; log invalidated for re-certification
